question: If (a)/(b) = (7)/(6), the find the value of the expression (6a+13b)/(6a-13b).
solution:
**Given**

a/b = 7/6

**Concept used**

Combining ratio

**Calculation**

a/b = 7/6 = k

a = 7k and b = 6k

⇒ (6a+13b)/(6a-13b)

⇒ (6 × 7k + 13 × 6k)/(6 ×​ 7k - 13 × 6k)

⇒ (120k)/(- 36k)

⇒ -10/3

**The value is -10/3.**
